mapper.select: SELECT DATE(borrow_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM lib_borrow WHERE borrow_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(borrow_time) ORDER BY d

SELECT b.book_id AS bookId, b.book_name AS bookName, b.book_author AS bookAuthor, COUNT(*) AS borrowCnt FROM lib_borrow br JOIN lib_book b ON br.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY br.book_id, b.book_name, b.book_author ORDER BY borrowCnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(borrow_status IN ('0', '2')), 0) AS active_total, COALESCE(SUM(borrow_status = '2'), 0) AS overdue FROM lib_borrow
SELECT COUNT(*) AS kinds, COALESCE(SUM(book_count), 0) AS stock_total, COALESCE(SUM(borrow_count), 0) AS borrowed FROM lib_book

SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(o.overdue_cnt, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(f.unpaid_cnt, 0) > 0 OR u.demon_value >= 30 THEN 'demon' ELSE 'spirit' END AS nature, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM lib_user u LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS overdue_cnt FROM lib_borrow WHERE borrow_status = '2' GROUP BY user_id) o ON o.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS unpaid_cnt FROM lib_fine WHERE fine_status = '0' GROUP BY user_id) f ON f.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY nature
SELECT DAYOFWEEK(borrow_time) - 1 AS weekday, HOUR(borrow_time) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM lib_borrow GROUP BY weekday, hour

SELECT c.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM lib_borrow br JOIN lib_book b ON br.book_id = b.book_id JOIN lib_category c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE br.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY cnt DESC

SELECT b.book_id AS bookId, b.book_name AS bookName, b.book_author AS bookAuthor, COUNT(br.borrow_id) AS borrowCnt FROM lib_book b LEFT JOIN lib_borrow br ON br.book_id = b.book_id WHERE b.category_id = #{categoryId} AND b.book_id NOT IN (SELECT book_id FROM lib_borrow WHERE user_id = #{userId}) GROUP BY b.book_id, b.book_name, b.book_author ORDER BY borrowCnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
